title: 8th Grade Math Quiz
description: Ten questions for 8th graders: two-step equations, the Pythagorean theorem, slope and scientific notation, with explanations.

questions.question: A right triangle has legs of 6 and 8. What is the length of the hypotenuse?
questions.explanation: a² + b² = c², so c² = 36 + 64 = 100 and c = 10.

questions.question: What is the slope of the line through (2, 3) and (6, 11)?
Write 0.00045 in scientific notation.
questions.explanation: Move the decimal 4 places right to get 4.5, so the power is −4: 4.5 × 10⁻⁴.

questions.question: A right triangle has a hypotenuse of 13 and one leg of 5. What is the other leg?
What is (2 × 10³) × (3 × 10²)?
questions.explanation: Multiply the coefficients: 2 × 3 = 6. Add the exponents: 3 + 2 = 5. Result: 6 × 10⁵.

questions.question: What is the slope of the line y = −2x + 7?
questions.explanation: In y = mx + b, m is the slope, so the slope is −2.

questions.question: A 10-foot ladder leans against a wall with its foot 6 feet from the wall. How high up the wall does it reach?
questions.explanation: The ladder is the hypotenuse: height² = 10² − 6² = 100 − 36 = 64, so the height is 8 feet.
